description.p: A fullscreen GTK4/libadwaita home screen for the Nuxel phone platform. Displays a status bar with time, network, battery, and notification indicators, along with a launcher grid of PWA and native apps.
Supports drag-to-reorder apps, tap-to-launch PWAs via Chromium, and native-placeholder stubs for future built-in apps.
Nuxel Home v0.6.6-beta — aligned with Nuxel Phone OS v0.6.6-beta (A77 USB-detach truth: the PC and Live Console lockscreen penguins clear when the cable is unplugged).

ul.li: PC / Live Console indicators fall with the real USB data link
Launcher cache advanced to v45-a77-usb-detach
Whole-repo version bump in lockstep with the Nuxel OS v0.6.6-beta release
No shell surface redesign
